_comment_1: Lok Purusha row layout. Each row is [leftCount, rightCount] — squares to the LEFT of the central trasanadi gap and squares to the RIGHT. The gap is always 1 column wide.
_comment_2: Sum of all (left + right) MUST equal 84 (BOARD_SIZE). Vite hot-reloads on save.
_comment_3: Square 1 sits at the BOTTOM row, square 84 at the TOP. Numbering walks bottom-up in an S-pattern, crossing the gap mid-row.
_comment_4: A row written as [0,1] (or [1,0]) — i.e. left+right == 1 — collapses to a single cell parked IN the central column. Use this at the apex to stack squares 84 and 83 vertically.
_comment_5: Row widths are tuned so every cell sits inside the frozen lokSilhouette.json outline. Max row width is [4,4] (9 columns including gap) — this also sets layout.width.
